rationale: The screenplay is an exceptionally faithful adaptation that covers every major beat, character arc, and thematic element from Dickens' source text with near-verbatim dialogue and accurate narrative progression across all five Staves. Character descriptions are visually stable and era-appropriate with clear disambiguation of age variants (boy Scrooge, young apprentice Scrooge, etc.). The script is highly directable for AI video generation, with concrete, observable actions, one-beat-per-clip structure, and explicit sound cues that support photoreal Victorian production. Pacing follows the book's emotional rhythm effectively, though minor condensation of descriptive passages slightly compresses some reflective moments. Dialogue preserves authentic subtext and period voice. Sound design is richly specified with practical cues for ghosts, bells, and atmosphere, providing strong scoring guidance. No invented plot points, structural breaks, or casting violations exist; the work is production-ready as a self-contained, source-true screenplay.
